detail: p3_ep14_script.md: Why does the Sun come back every morning? Cycles (Cycles opener p. 73 + Ch 4, pp. 74-75). Part 1 Why Does the Sun Come BACK Every Morning? (EP13's dare answered: the Earth turns; the sky over two days; the globe and the torch; rotation; what a cycle is; pencil or traffic light; 520 words, about 4:55-5:08), Part 2 The Boy GREW. The Tree GREW. Why Not the TEDDY BEAR? (then and now; one chick week after week; a life cycle; Pip's notes; why life cycles matter; 525 words, about 5:00-5:12). Six look-closers, two journeys (be the little red dot, be a chick), owl and ladybird, dare into EP15 (a mango seed: what will it grow into first: a mango, a flower, a young plant). Dare wording in one block (section 3). Covers pp. 73-75 of the classic 'What Happens After You Plant A Seed? Round And Round' (pp. 73-79, RVRoaWWKjEM): it retires only when EP15 is live.
